explication: HomeDock OS is a self-hosted cloud desktop: a user opens a browser desktop, launches installed apps or built-in file tools, and manages apps and personal storage there. The product spans desktop/window state, app installation and Docker control, file access and previews, system settings, and secure app routing. The README documents these capabilities; source excerpts and the index confirm selected implementation links, so unsampled subsystem connections are omitted or marked unverified.
